Maybe my `cands` computation is broken (e.g., the condition for the wait step is wrong — `bm[u//N][u%N] + F.werr[u]` uses the werr of the source cell ✓, since wait goes from u→v; `(am...) + 1 == (eb,ea)` ✓; incoming hops: loop over pu... this is O(V × deg) per cell → O(V²) — with P·N ~ small (around 30) no problem... but the cases might also be silently failing early (`return None, None` when a cell has no candidates — cells with (0,0) have no candidates (anchors): cands is empty → returns None → skipped!).
